identityPolicy: The six base anchors are immutable. Create new poses and scenes by editing a base reference; never regenerate or overwrite a base.
styleLock: Hand-drawn cartoon zine style, thick dark outline, wobbly imperfect pen line, muted paper palette, round black glasses, friendly closed mouth, chunky rounded body, short legs, upright pose. No gradients, gloss, neon, photorealism, 3D render, or logo.

world.usage: Atmosphere and lore only. Never crop this image into a character portrait.

characters.name: Riff
characters.identity: Warm golden-ochre giraffe with soft burnt-orange spots, long neck, two ossicones, red sweater vest, white collar, round glasses, grey clipboard.
characters.antiDrift: Keep the long neck, ossicones, spots, and clipboard. Never horse, llama, neon, glossy, or photoreal.

characters.name: Rex
characters.identity: Cool mid-grey rhino with a lighter dove-grey belly, one small stubby nose horn, small rounded ears, calm expression, round glasses, and a coral-red quilted puffer vest over a navy crewneck.
characters.antiDrift: Keep one small nose horn and a grey body. Never hippo, brown, terracotta, glossy, or photoreal.

characters.name: Coco
characters.identity: Fluffy cream Great Pyrenees or bichon puppy dog with floppy curly ears, round glasses, black button nose, tiny pink tongue, a muted sage buttoned cardigan, and an amber coffee mug.
characters.antiDrift: Coco is a dog, never a duck, bird, bear, or human. Keep the furry snout, black button nose, cream fur, sage cardigan, and amber mug.

characters.name: Zi
characters.identity: Muted slate-blue and cream penguin with orange beak and feet, round glasses, charcoal shirt with a tiny coral terminal glyph, headphones at the neck, one flipper raised.
characters.antiDrift: Keep orange beak and feet, slate-blue and cream body, learner energy, headphones, and compact penguin silhouette.

characters.name: Fin
characters.identity: Muted periwinkle blue-violet great-white-shark with cream lower belly, one small triangular head fin, two tiny white teeth, round glasses, coral-red pullover hoodie with white drawstrings, and one black marker.
characters.antiDrift: Keep one head fin, two small teeth, periwinkle body, cream belly, coral hoodie, and black marker. Never dolphin, whale, grey, true purple, aggressive, or double-finned.

characters.name: Frosty
characters.identity: Sage-green koala with fluffy cream ear tufts, large black nose, round glasses, coral-red rolled-collar sweater, and an open amber book.
characters.antiDrift: Keep sage-green fur, cream ear tufts, large black nose, coral sweater, and amber book. Never grey, brown, or teddy bear.
